entities.summary: The Center of the Tokyo Raids and War Damage  is a museum in Tokyo, Japan that presents information and artifacts related to the bombing of Tokyo during World War II. The museum opened in 2002 and was renovated in 2005, the 60th anniversary of the bombings. In 2012, the Center presented an exhibition of 700 previously unseen photos from the bombing. As of 2022, the center received fewer than 10,000 visitors annually.
